messages:
sgupta: Heads up — seeing a bump in fncall validation rejects after the v2.4.1 canary. Most failures are from one tool adapter returning a top-level array where we expect an object -> validator rejects, request falls back to degen route.

jxu: can you paste an example payload?

sgupta: sure, here's one from the trace (redacted):
```
[{
  "name": "fetch_items",
  "payload": [{"id": "123"}, {"id": "124"}]
}]
```
We expect `{ "tool_response": { "items": [...] } }` but got array instead. Validator in strict mode treats that as a shape mismatch.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary v2.4.1 -> eu-west1 (5% traffic) — rolled at 2026-03-20T09:12Z :rocket:

mae: hmm. two immediate ideas:
1) short-term: enable a "soft-validate/coerce" path that converts top-level array -> {"items": thatArray} and tag the request so we can count it
2) long-term: require tool adapters to normalize responses (follow schema)
Also we should emit a metric like `fncall.tool_shape_mismatch.v2` with tags `{coerced:true|false, tool_name, route_id}` so dashboards can filter.

jxu: i worry about quotas/billing: if we auto-coerce and return success we shouldn't charge the customer for a rejected invocation. We also need to avoid inflating strict-mode reject counts that trigger rollbacks.

sgupta: agreed. proposal:
- implement soft-validate flag (default off) that attempts coercion and marks the response with `validator.coerce=array->object` in telemetry
- do NOT increment billing or strict-reject counters when coercion happens; increment a distinct counter `fncall.coerced_responses`
- expose per-customer toggle in console so support can enable for a tenant while we fix adapter

mae: console UX: add toggle under Console > Tooling > FnCalls: "Soft-validate / Coerce legacy tool shapes" with rollout options (off, canary %, on). Also add a kpi card and link to sampled examples S3 path. We'll need a backend flag + audit log.

ops-runbook: Runbook note: if `fncall.coerced_responses / fncall.total_invocations > 0.01` for 10m -> page eng-platform oncall and trigger canary rollback. (This rule already exists for strict rejects; adding coerced ratio as a new threshold.)

jxu: also add sampled request dump for the coerced cases (1% sampling) to `s3://redwood-fncall/coercions/{date}/` and post daily digest into #eng-platform-digests so PMs can review.

sgupta: plan of record:
- i'll open PR for validator soft-mode + telemetry tag (coerce counter + tag)
- mae: mock console toggle + audit log UI
- jxu: dashboard panel + sampling job + s3 path
I'll run an internal canary: 5% -> monitor 30m -> 25% -> 100% if stable. :thumbsup:

mae: ack, setting up mock and will include rollout steps in the PR description. I'll add the console permission check (support vs admin).

jxu: i'll wire metrics and add a Grafana panel and alert; will include cost impact notes (no billing increment on coerced flows).

sgupta: thanks. if anyone sees new adapter that returns arrays, ping me and include traces. We'll revert canary if anything spikes.

deploy-bot: noted: watch rule configured for `fncall.coerced_responses` alert -> eng-platform oncall.

ops-runbook: runbook updated: https://internal/runbooks/fncall-coercion (entries: detection, rollback, customer-comms template).
